pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Swarm**. A peer path.

There are no bees to find in the void, so you make somewhere a bee wants to be: a ring of oak logs around a small flower on the pad. Wait. Wings. Every nest is that trick with a different ring.

Finish the **Swarm Knot** and seat Swarm. Keep something alive that keeps something else alive.

pages.title: Colony
pages.text: The Colony-keepers did not own their colonies. They were on good terms with them. That is the whole of the method.
